svg.title: Life expectancy, 1960 to 2020
svg.desc: A world map colored by life expectancy at birth plays through 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, with a legend. The countries then morph into circles sized by population in 2020, and into a bar chart of the ten most populous countries. Life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN) and population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), from the World Bank's World Development Indicators, retrieved October 2026.

g.text: Years a newborn can expect to live, 1960 to 2020
Circle area is population in 2020. Color is life expectancy in 2020.
The ten most populous countries, 2020 (millions of people)
